scripts.build: bun run build:bundles && tsc -b packages/identity packages/model packages/runtime packages/player packages/exporters packages/exporter-html5 packages/exporter-scorm12 packages/exporter-scorm2004 packages/exporter-xapi packages/exporter-cmi5 packages/exporter-aicc
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages apps/web scripts
scripts.build:web: bun run --cwd apps/web prisma generate && NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd apps/web build
